name: Optimus

source.quote: August 19, 2021, at Tesla's AI Day event
The new Optimus hand later this year will have 22 DoF
April 22, 2026 (Q1 Earnings Call): Musk estimated the robot would be "available for purchase at around US$30,000."

timeline.detail: Tesla reveals plans for a humanoid robot (initially "Tesla Bot") at AI Day; presented by a person in a costume, not a functioning unit.

source.quote: August 19, 2021, at Tesla's AI Day event

timeline.detail: No customer deliveries confirmed; Tesla states production lines are being installed at Fremont with full-scale manufacturing targeted for 2027.

source.quote: April 2026: Production lines being installed in Fremont; full-scale manufacturing targeted for 2027
Today I'm assisted by a human. I'm not yet fully autonomous

capabilities.note: At Tesla's 'We, Robot' event (2024-10-10), one of the Optimus units present told a guest it was human-assisted; independently observed and reported by multiple attendees/press (Fortune, Bloomberg, Cybernews), not a Tesla press claim.

source.quote: Totally worthy to celebrate low latency remote control, but totally dishonest to demo these as autonomous robots—call it the parlor trick it is.

capabilities.note: Optimus units poured drinks and interacted with guests at the We, Robot event; Lux Capital cofounder Josh Wolfe's remark confirms remote control was used for at least some units, but Tesla has not disclosed which specific actions were teleoperated vs. scripted/autonomous, so this pick-and-place-style interaction is recorded as unknown rather than autonomous or teleoperated by default.

notes: No unit has been sold or delivered to an external customer as of 2026-09-20; Tesla's own working demos (walking, sorting, dancing) qualify as demonstrated, not shipped.

Primary sourcing gap: tesla.com/AI returned HTTP 403 and Tesla's investor-relations PDFs were not reachable directly during this build; the figures above are Tesla's own stated numbers as compiled by Wikipedia with named dates and events (AI Day 2021, Q1 2026 earnings call), not independent journalism repeating a rumor. This should be replaced with a direct tesla.com or ir.tesla.com citation in a follow-up.

hand_dof (22 DoF) is Elon Musk's own statement (May 2024, as reported by Teslarati) about an upcoming hand upgrade, recorded as claimed; by 2026 multiple outlets describe this as the current Gen 3/V3 hand shipping in low volume, but no direct tesla.com spec page confirming the current production hand DOF was reachable during this build.

The teleoperation-shown capability documents the well-publicized fact that at least some We, Robot (Oct 2024) Optimus units were human-operated; this does not establish the current DOF or autonomy of any other demonstrated Optimus capability, which remain separately unsourced for autonomy.
